lines.l: I would've listened to my friends, they always know best
They said you were just like all the rest
So now sing it loud in case you don't already know
Pack up your stuff and go
Pack up your stuff and go
You said it was a one-time thing
You don't know what you were thinking
That it didn't mean anything
You promised you were not good again
So when you get messed up on a night out
How many times have you played around?
Was I a fool, didn't see the signs
I guess my friends were always right
Pack up your stuff and go
Pack up your stuff and go
Dance, dance
Dance hits
I came here with a broken heart that no one else could see
I drew a smile on my face, took paper over me
But wounds heal when tears dry and cracks they don't show
